text: You shouldn't be here during the day. It makes Set unhappy. Come back at night
source_text: You shouldn't be here during the day. It makes Set unhappy. Come back at night

text: 白天你不应该出现在这儿。赛特会不高兴的。晚上再来吧。

text: He should learn to deal with his problems.

text: 他应该学着自己处理问题.
source_text: 他应该学着自己处理问题.

text: That's not important. What is important is that I speak with him.

text: 这并不重要。重要的是我和他说的话。

text: Is this all I get? I deserve more, and you'd better give it to me!

text: 这就是我得到的所有东西？我本应得到更多，你最好给我！

text: You need to leave here . . . immediately.

text: Follow me. I'll see to your reward.
source_text: Follow me. I'll see to your reward.

text: I hope not, for your sake. Set was not too happy to have to use you. It might be a good idea to leave Necropolis . . . soon

text: 我希望不是，因为你的缘故。赛特可不太高兴我们不得不利用你。离开大墓地是个好主意……最好快点。

text: Perhaps. Hmm. Here, take this as well.

text: 或许吧。嗯嗯。这里，再拿着这。

text: Hmm. Some things are missing from the fridge. It seems that we have been robbed.
